obituaries.full_text:
MILLSBORO: Clarence S. Morris, 77, a retired farmer, died Sunday at Milford Memorial Hospital after a long illness.

He is survived by his widow, Mrs. Saddie Morris, Millsboro; a step-son, George Sammons, Millsboro; two step-daughters, Mrs. Merrill Harmon and Mrs. Arzie Clark, both of Millsboro; 18 grandchildren, 31 great-grandchildren; one brother, Arleonardo C. Morris, Millsboro; three sisters, Mrs. May Jackson, Mrs. Arrie Wright, both of Millsboro and Mrs. Sarah Morris of Bridgeton, N.J.

Funeral services will be Thursday at 2 p.m. at Harmony Church, Millsboro. Friends may call at the James  Funeral Home tomorrow evening 7 t0 9.

Edgar C. Morris, Sr.
